changelog.title: Complete WSA Course
changelog.description: Full 20-module Windows Server Administration course with GUI labs, PowerShell labs, and quizzes for each module.

changelog.title: OUTPOST Midterm Project
changelog.description: Branch office deployment scenario combining skills from modules 1-10 in a realistic infrastructure build.

changelog.title: FAILSAFE Capstone
changelog.description: Disaster recovery simulation where you restore a failed domain controller and document the incident.

changelog.title: 80+ Interactive Labs
changelog.description: GUI and PowerShell simulations covering AD, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, IIS, PKI, Hyper-V, and more.

changelog.title: Continue Exploring
changelog.description: All labs now feature a dismiss button so you can keep practicing after completing objectives.
